A '''Brock-Eight cannon''' was a type of [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] [[Cannon/Legends|cannon]]. In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], a number of Brock-Eight cannons were used by a [[Unidentified Nosaurian mercenary|Nosaurian mercenary]] during a [[Battle of Gazzari|battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gazzari]].
